item.content:encoded:
Hey, thanks psul, glad you like it better!

Also, I did end up changing the opening somewhat, a few days back. Hopefully the twist isn't as obvious as before, but still obvious enough. Like you say, it's a delicate balance, and I didn't want to risk upsetting it, so the changes were minimal.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I like the new ending *much* better - I think this definitely a less-is-more situation. As to your PM question about the opening, I think it's fine to leave as is - it's a delicate balance to strike between being too obvious for some or too obscure for others, and it seems to be working at the moment.

I can't do anything to change the numbers, but know that my upvote has gone from tentative to solid :)

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I actually didn't see it coming. Which is to say, I thought all the references to what they were eating were meant to contrast with the budget cuts. I.e., they're going from living like kings to living like the still-well-to-do. And then soylent meat was D-Class and I'm just not sure what to take from that.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Oh shit damn fuck, I upvoted before realising you'd changed the end.
And I cannot upvote again.
Shit. Life's too hard.

Excellent job, Herc! I do agree with Psul on this:

I'm a fan of the concept, and much prefer it to many of the contest entries - there's a kernel of nastiness which feels so right.

and also with (SPOILER)

+ show block
– hide block

I realised quite quickly where this was going (when each of the first three speeches refers to a particular type of action, Chekov's gun starts to apply).

The first time I read it, I went: "Oh. Steak, lasagna, meatballs. Mmmmmmh….!"

Never mind. I liked both endings, and I love subtle writing!

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Yeah, the ending was initially a lot more subtle, relying wholly on the Chekov's gun to drive the point home, and ending with the sentence "Well, at least the food's still decent". I preferred that version TBH, but was told it was too subtle, so I changed it. It was hard striking the right balance, but this is the version that received the best reaction in the forums. Your comment is making me consider changing the ending again, though… maybe just ending with "at least meat's back on the menu"?

Glad you still liked parts of it, in any case - including the title. :)

EDIT: Fuck it, I changed it. YOLO. Hopefully this is better now. The word "meat" in the last line should be enough for people to get what's going on, I think.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I'm a fan of the concept, and much prefer it to many of the contest entries - there's a kernel of nastiness which feels so right.

That said, I realised quite quickly where this was going (when each of the first three speeches refers to a particular type of action, Chekov's gun starts to apply). As such, I found the last few lines very clunky and obvious, which undermined the dry tone.

I was all set to downvote, when I finally got hit by the pun in the title. That was sufficiently subtle for my tastes, and worth upvoting.

item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
So I originally wrote this as an entry for the D-class contest, but alas, twasn’t meant to be.

My undying gratitude to MrWrong, Eta Carinae, Erazm and El Jimeiro for some excellent feedback, as well as to Dexanote for providing feedback and answering my contest-related questions.

+ Spoilers
- Hide

I was tempted to call this Soylent D, but that would have spoiled the whole ending for those who got that reference. Hence, Budget Cuts.
